name: Serafina Renatus
original_name: セラフィーナ・レナトゥス
source:
An ancient High Elf who lies in the temple of the Holy Kingdom. She is believed to be the reincarnation of the goddess Laurendeau, who is believed to awaken when the world is in danger and save the people of Eos. She is modest and graceful, with an alluring charm that even evokes a sense of fragility.
Although she has never been a stranger to conflict, she sees the expanding service state as a threat to the world and decides to fight. She and Iris share a friendship that transcends race and ethnicity.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1014490]Getchu[/url]]
